trans.sense: kind of approximation of an integral

categories: English entries with incorrect language header
raw_glosses: (mathematics) A certain kind of approximation of an integral by a finite sum that is calculated by dividing the interval of integration into smaller sub-intervals and summing sample values of the integrand inside those sub-intervals multiplied by their lengths.
